source: Synthetic, against the public sample app. Seeded defects: toggleAll() crashes on an empty list; it decides by the first book only, so a mixed list where the first is read marks everything unread (breaks AC-1); the test asserts only the length, so it can't fail for the criterion. Bait: none.
